title: Still swiping? Part 1
note: Silent. Frame 1 is fully composed with NO fade and ONE strip (the hook, 0-3.0, y=345): two large faces, both thumbs swiping (generic card glow only, no app UI), the big tent card centre. Her name is never shown this part. Her Sharpie '(still swiping?)' is already on the card in frame 1. Own payoff before the vote: she out-swipes him on the card ('since the bread'), both laugh, both phones go face down on the same beat (12.9). Then she asks '(why table 9?)'. Vote A I'M GREAT AT WEDDINGS / B I'M NOT. HENCE TABLE 9. Part 2 plays A first and it fails on HIM (brag, the dance floor finds him), lazy Susan spins backwards as the rewind; B is the planned winner (honest, makes her laugh). No NoSwipe mention. Safe zone: all text between y=270 and y=1250. Lazy Susan transition used twice (14.2, 19.8). Times in seconds.

hooks.a: The stranger beside me at this wedding swipes too.
hooks.b: A stranger at the singles table rewrites my place card.

choices.question: why table nine? what should I write?
choices.why: B is honest and funny, matches the account's dry tone and the shared laugh already earned; A is a brag, so part 2 can make it fail on him alone (the DJ finds him, the dance floor) without touching her.
choices.part2: A plays first, tagged take 1: I'M GREAT AT WEDDINGS. She raises one eyebrow, the DJ calls everyone to the floor, he loses to the dance floor; the lazy Susan spins backwards (rewind). Take 2: I'M NOT. HENCE TABLE 9. She laughs, phones stay face down, next vote about him.
